analysis.duration_definition: Observed contiguous owner errors, in camera frames; gaps/end right-censored. Not CLEAR IDSW, not fps-converted seconds
analysis.false_merge_definition: A predicted native ID observed with more than one known GT over this run; posthoc complete-video diagnostic with duplicate GT UNKNOWN, not actor input
analysis.index_definition: Actual predicted Global ID lookup into already committed other-camera observations; no whole-video GT-selected ID mapping; UNKNOWN retrieved observations excluded from known precision and counted separately
analysis.owner_definition: Immutable first known observed GT per native ID; duplicate GT ids per camera/frame UNKNOWN; not a future-safety certificate
analysis.preservation_definition: Fraction of known rows keeping each person first observed owner-correct predicted native ID, including its own anchor row; per-run causal anchor, not cross-run numeric-ID equality or proof of restoring a baseline ID

analysis.owner_definition: Immutable first known observed GT per native ID; duplicate GT ids per camera/frame UNKNOWN; not a future-safety certificate
analysis.preservation_definition: Fraction of known rows keeping each person first observed owner-correct predicted native ID, including its own anchor row; per-run causal anchor, not cross-run numeric-ID equality or proof of restoring a baseline ID
